workflow.user_action: Launch compatible editor, save and reconcile remote version
workflow.output: Verified new version or recoverable unsynced change with explicit reason
workflow.exceptions_and_dependencies: Tracked-path changes, stale credentials, permission loss, absent handler and template configuration require real execution. Proposed safeguards exceed what static source images prove.

acceptance_test.scenario_and_expected_result: Open synthetic PDF D1/V1, change text and use ordinary Save. Show download, editor launch, local save, upload started and remote-version verified as distinct states. Verify the returned version ID, byte hash and reopened content. Then use Save As and move the local file: preserve the unsynced edits, identify the broken binding and offer reviewed recovery without silently replacing a different remote document. Test an editor that writes through a temporary rename, offline save, permission revocation, failed upload and a timeout after remote acceptance. Retry reconciles the existing version before uploading; no duplicate versions or false success. A notification or refresh is not proof of saved remote bytes.

acceptance_test.scenario_and_expected_result: Use two synthetic organizations with identical filenames and overlapping-looking project IDs. Open Org A/D1, switch the browser to Org B and request Org B/D1. Revalidate user/org authorization for each launch and save; an old Org A callback cannot overwrite Org B. If reauthentication is required, show a blocked/recoverable state. Test sign-out, app quit, relaunch and revoked access separately, keeping unsent work attributable to its original context. Notifications disabled or suppressed by a meeting must not be interpreted as no operation or successful completion. After more than two minutes without opening, expose diagnostics and the failed stage rather than spawning unlimited editor sessions.

acceptance_test.scenario_and_expected_result: Configure one fixed widget using approved T1 and one project-choice widget with authorized T1/T2. Verify only project types with the correct widget/connection expose generation. A fixed widget cannot be changed to T2 through a stale UI or request. A selectable widget shows only templates permitted for that project and user. Changing the widget prompt auto-populates its selector under an explicit collision-safe rule; inspect rather than assume selector stability after later renaming. Validate contact/collection fields from other sections of the same matter without leaking another matter. Pin the approved template edition and source data, preserve I/me/my and four-digit date years, and reject generation if connection or required fields are unresolved.

extensions.title: Office route compatibility and launch evidence
extensions.test: Test the documented Office type matrix:doc/docx,xls/xlsx,vsdx,pub,ppt/pptx,mpp. Verify lowercase and uppercase extensions separately; the guide requires lowercase. Check Windows/Office2013+ and current macOS/Office2016+ as documented prerequisites, not a current security support guarantee. Test desktop/mobile with/without the relevant installed app and project/edit permission. Denying the browser launch prompt must remain cancelled, never opened/saved. Confirm saved bytes through every existing project reference.

extensions.title: Version receipts after native edits
extensions.test: Capture original and new remote version IDs/hashes and reopen both. A save-started OS notification and a visible Version5 screenshot do not establish the current edit reached storage. Test stale preview requiring refresh, retry after partial upload and duplicate callback handling without corrupting the version history.

extensions.title: Editing lease recovery after sign-out or quit
extensions.test: Sign out or quit with a dirty native file and an active lock. Keep recoverable edits and an attributable session. Reauthentication or relaunch must not blindly release or reuse another user’s lock; reconcile stale sessions and permissions before a late save. Capture separate evidence for client failure, lock status and remote accepted version.

extensions.title: Managed installation and diagnostic-log boundaries
extensions.test: Verify an authorized admin obtains the correct OS installer through the documented resource route and records actual version/publisher/integrity evidence. Do not automatically bypass endpoint policy because a guide suggests running past a warning. Test managed approval, missing default handlers and each device/user separately. Collect only reviewed/redacted error logs from the documented platform-specific location; never expose credentials or unrelated case content. Source statements about Electron or platform authorization are not independent binary verification.
